title: Even the Wind and the Sea

request.style: English, hard-driving rock, powerful raspy male vocal, distorted guitars, thundering drums, growling bass, stormy verses breaking into a sudden quiet then a huge chorus, 138 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Let's cross over to the other side, he said when evening fell
We left the crowd along the shore and rode into the swell
The sky went black, the squall came down, the water filled the hull
And Jesus in the stern was sleeping on a cushion through it all

[Pre-Chorus]
Teacher, don't you care that we're going to drown?

[Chorus]
He got up and rebuked the wind
Quiet! Be still!
The wind died down, and there was a great calm
Who is this?
Even the wind and the sea obey him!

[Verse]
We bailed with buckets, bailed with hands, we shouted through the roar
The waves broke over every side, we could not see the shore
We fishermen who knew the lake were certain we would drown
And still he slept there in the stern while the sea was crashing down

[Pre-Chorus]
Teacher, don't you care that we're going to drown?

[Chorus]
He got up and rebuked the wind
Quiet! Be still!
The wind died down, and there was a great calm
Who is this?
Even the wind and the sea obey him!

[Bridge]
Why are you so afraid?
Do you still have no faith?
Why are you so afraid?
Do you still have no faith?

[Chorus]
He got up and rebuked the wind
Quiet! Be still!
The wind died down, and there was a great calm
Who is this?
Even the wind and the sea obey him!

[Outro]
Who is this?
Even the wind and the sea obey him!
